cases.name: summary
cases.question: Summarize how to start using this board and its main hardware limitations. Include flash/SRAM/EEPROM capacities and VIN/USB voltage limits.
cases.answer: To start using the Arduino UNO R3, install the Arduino Desktop IDE and connect via USB-B cable for power and programming, or use the Arduino Cloud Editor with a plugin. Main hardware limitations include: ATmega328P processor with 32 kB Flash, 2 kB SRAM, 1 kB EEPROM; VIN maximum input voltage is 20 V; USB maximum input voltage is 5.5 V.
